12th March 2026

March 12, 2026

This is my first blog

Okay, not really, but I was lying around like a vegetable and feeling really useless. And I thought I should express myself, or else I will lose my mind. I do not particularly feel like talking with anyone as of now. Everyone is busy with their own life. And anyways, there is a time for everything, and right now, it is time for me to be alone.
I am trying to read the Illiad. There are some clear Roman influences in this. "By Jove" - that looks like Roman naming. Hera, Jupiter, Vulcan all sound like Roman names of the Gods. Reading this story is also not easy. I got to push through.
I love the breakfast burrito at Guzman Y Gomez. I quite like Mexican food, and it is currently in fashion for me.
I didnt go to the gym today, and I feel like crap. Like kind of guilty.
I am also trying to figure out this markdown thing. Looks like to go to the next line in the text, I need to have double space or double new line for the text to go to the new line. Okay this should be enough text for now, I want to publish this in my website now.
When you are hungry, the only thing in your mind is food. All other things become stupid and inconsequential. Only thing in your mind is food. How important this is. Food.
With war and hardship coming around the corner, how to get above it? Obviously the person who makes food will be able to survive. Or atleast, the people who have the means to get food. But in our current society, the makers of food are in the most rough possible lifestyle from what it looks like. Okay that is not true, getting on a tractor and blocking Delhi looks pretty cool. But atleast in my family, being a farmer is not looked highly upon. I would need to be physically fit and be able to do a lot of things. And I believe I wont be the only one with this problem. There are 6 million people in Singapore who are not farmers and need food from outside.
How weird it is. A whole city full of people who are too busy in their shenanigans and then you have farmers in another part of the globe. Do they live good lives? Are they like the "slavs" I imagine them to be? From my home town they are called "Kaamlaas" as in the people who work on the fields. They are not that materialistic, in the sense that they are not that wealthy. But they sure can do a lot of work. I see them doing the menial work at my house. They seem very thin but very fit. They are very sturdy it seems. Someone in my family said that we would have been them. I doubt it but I do see it: our physical features are quite similar but I am way more chubby.
Actually I have no idea how a farmer's life is. I need to do some research on this... that is if I want to. There is a gazillion things I have to do. I just do not feel like. I do not feel like doing anything. There seems to be nothing worth to do. I lack any direction or motivation. I feel like sleeping but I cannot sleep: my sleep schedule is messed up again. Maybe I can push myself to work on something. I do not know.
I am now finding out that it is possible to do "work" even with your stomach crying for food. It is kind of distracting. I want to eat something, a snack or anything else really. Some fruit. A sweet. Something savory. The curry O's (not sure what they are called) from Old Chang Kee is very tasty. But I should go to the gym first. Then I will take a shower and then head for the Bangladeshi food. Nothing like fish and rice.
